content.title: Which black hole modes ring freely? Horizon regularity, the forced ringdown transient, and GW250114
content.abstract: The quasinormal modes (QNMs) of a black hole are defined by keeping only ingoing waves at the horizon. We ask what horizon regularity requires of the outgoing waves this condition discards. For a scalar-like perturbation, bounded first derivatives in a frame regular at the future horizon rule out outgoing waves that decay more slowly than the surface gravity $κ$, and smoothness singles out a ladder of frequencies, $ω=mΩ_{\rm H}-ijκ$ with $j=1,2,\dots$ and $Ω_{\rm H}$ the horizon angular velocity.
